subject: biology
title: The DNA Inside You
welcome_lead: Unzip the secret code that decides what you look like and how your body works.
meta_desc: KS3 Biology adventure on DNA, genes and where inheritance starts.
final_note: You can now describe DNA and genes — the basis of all inheritance.

concepts.def: Section of DNA controlling one feature.
Long thread of DNA in the nucleus.
Passing traits from parents to children.

walkthroughs.body_html: DNA is found inside the nucleus of every cell. It is packaged into chromosomes. Each chromosome carries many genes.
A gene is a small section of DNA that controls one feature, such as eye colour or hair colour. You inherit half your genes from each parent.
Sex cells (sperm and egg) carry half a set of chromosomes. At fertilisation they combine to give a new cell with a full set, mixing features from both parents.
